title: Visa: on-chain agent payments sit near $50,000 a week
summary: Visa's crypto lead Cuy Sheffield said on-chain agent payments across the x402 and MPP protocols run at roughly $50,000 a week and have been flat for six to eight months. The same report contrasts this with fast growth in card and wallet based agent spending.
whyItMatters: Agent spending is scaling on cards and wallets far faster than on crypto rails, which shapes where banks and networks should build.
